literal_meaning: একটি ছোট চাট্টির মতো পরিমাণ বা চারটি খানি
example_sentences_in_english: Give me just a little rice.
He has only a small amount of money.
note: This idiom reflects everyday rural or semi-urban Bengali life, emphasizing scarcity in portions, with 'চারটিখানি' as a close variant implying four small pieces.
